name: list_documents
description: List the documents currently open in Werkbank (id, name, page count, path, unsaved changes). Use the id as `document` in other tools; without it, tools act on the active document.

name: open_document
description: Open a PDF (or Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image …, converted to PDF) from a path on this computer. It becomes the active document.

name: get_info
description: Basic facts about a document: pages, page sizes, title/author, form fields, signatures, attachments, bookmarks.

name: get_text
description: Extract text in reading order, page by page.

name: find_text
description: Find a phrase; returns page numbers and short context for each match.

name: render_page
description: Render one page as a PNG image to look at it.

name: add_comment
description: Add a comment. type highlight/underline/strike marks every occurrence of `find` (optionally only on `page`); type note places a sticky note with `text` on `page` (top left, or near the first match of `find`). Each call is one undoable step; nothing is saved until save_document.

find.description: Text to mark (highlight/underline/strike) or to place the note next to

text.description: Note text, or a comment attached to the markup

name: list_form_fields
description: List the form fields with name, type, current value and options.

name: fill_form
description: Fill form fields by name. Checkboxes take true/false, choice fields one of their options.

name: list_tools
description: List Werkbank's document tools that run_tool can execute (rotate, delete pages, compress, OCR, page numbers, watermark, redact by search, protect, convert …) with their parameters and defaults.

name: run_tool
description: Run a Werkbank tool from list_tools on a document. Parameters not given use their defaults. The change is one undoable step; nothing is saved until save_document.

name: undo
description: Undo the last change of a document.

name: save_document
description: Save the document to its file, or to `path` (Save As). Comments and form entries are appended so digital signatures stay valid where possible.
